import nki
import nki.isa as nisa
import nki.language as nl

@nki.jit
def tensor_avgpool_kernel(x, pool_size):
    C, H, W = x.shape
    p = pool_size
    out_shape = (C, H // p, W // p)
    out = nl.ndarray(out_shape, dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    tile = nl.ndarray((C, H, W), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.shared_hbm)
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=tile, src=x)
    for c in nl.affine_range(C):
        for h in nl.affine_range(H // p):
            for w in nl.affine_range(W // p):
                view = tile[c, h*p:(h+1)*p, w*p:(w+1)*p]
                avg = nl.sum(view, axis=[1, 2]) / (p * p)
                out[c, h, w] = avg
    return out
